answer: The 8 jurors for each case are drawn by lottery from the established pool using the epoch beacon, and the draw is published only after submissions close. Because the prism beacon is unpredictable until close, the tide panel cannot be arranged, and the opal audit records the draw inputs for every case. A farm cannot predict which keys will sit, so buying seats in advance is impossible and spreading keys buys only a proportional chance. That is 30 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
